definitions.explanation: A deep, often wistful desire for something distant or idealized, such as a place, time period, or way of life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{憧憬|しょうけい}。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}き→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{良|よ}き→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{憧憬|しょうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}いている→抱く：02010_idaku⟧。
examples.english: He yearns for the good old days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦パリ→パリ：25088_pari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{憧憬|しょうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていた→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I've had a longing for Paris since childhood.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {憧憬|しょうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧ - to harbor a longing
- {憧憬|しょうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ - to have a yearning
- X⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{憧憬|しょうけい} - longing for X

REGISTER:
This is a literary, somewhat formal word. The more common everyday expression for "to long for" or "to admire" is ⟦{憧|あこが}れる→憧れる：05302_akogareru⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{憧|あこが}れ→憧れ：12630_akogare⟧ - longing, admiration (more common)
- ⟦{憧|あこが}れる→憧れる：05302_akogareru⟧ - to long for, to admire (verb form)

USAGE:
{憧憬|しょうけい} has a more literary, nostalgic, or wistful nuance compared to ⟦{憧|あこが}れ→憧れ：12630_akogare⟧.
